Eur. includes the monohydrate. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Spirapril Hydrochloride Monohydrate). A white or almost white, fine crystalline powder. Very slightly soluble in water; slightly soluble in acetonitrile; practically insoluble in dichloromethane; soluble in methyl alcohol. Store in airtight containers. Protect from light. Profile Spirapril is an ACE inhibitor (p.1193) that is used in the manage- ment of hypertension (p.1171). It owes its activity to the diacid spiraprilat, to which it is converted after oral doses. It is given orally as the hydrochloride in a usual maintenance dose of 6 mg once daily. ◊ References. 1. Noble S, Sorkin EM.
